name: What is the difference between ozone treatment and thermal fogging for smoke removal?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between ozone treatment and thermal fogging for smoke removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ozone treatment and thermal fogging are both professional methods used for smoke odor removal, but they work differently. Ozone treatment uses an ozone generator to produce O3 molecules, which oxidize and neutralize odor-causing particles at a molecular level. It's highly effective for pervasive odors but requires furniture to be in an unoccupied, sealed space due to ozone's respiratory risks. Thermal fogging involves heating a liquid deodorizer to create a fine mist that penetrates porous materials, mimicking the way smoke penetrated. This method chemically neutralizes odors and can reach areas difficult to access, but also requires specialized application.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ozone treatment uses O3 molecules to oxidize odors, requiring an unoccupied space. Thermal fogging applies a heated mist that chemically neutralizes odors in porous materials. Both are professional methods.
